candidates.title: NYC Capital Projects Dashboard recorded actual construction end for MILL BASIN BR / BELT PARKWAY #2-23147-9/TN
candidates.summary: The NYC Capital Projects Dashboard citywide budget/schedule row records actual_construction_end 2019-10-04 for MILL BASIN BR / BELT PARKWAY #2-23147-9/TN. FMS project name: MILL BASIN BR / BELT PARKWAY #2-23147-9/TN; ten-year plan category: FAIR BRIDGES; managing/sponsor agency: DOT / DOT. Replacement of Shore (Belt) Parkway Bridge over Mill Basin, Brooklyn.The project consists of the removal of the existing fourteen (14) span bascule bridge (length 864 feet) and replacement with a seventeen (17) span fixed bridge (length 2,645 feet) elevated to provide a 60 foot vertical clearance over the navigational channel. The typical bridge section consists of a composite concrete deck and steel superstructure supported on a reinforced concrete substructure on concrete piles. The new bridge will be constructed on a new alignment set on the north side of the existing bridge, partially overlapping with the existing bridge. The new bridge and approach roadways will provide three (3) 12 foot wide lanes for vehicular traffic, a 12 foot wide right shoulder on the bridge and a 10 foot wide right shoulder on the approach roadways, a minimum 4 foot wide left shoulder in each direction, and a 12 foot wide bicycle / pedestrian facility adjacent to the eastbound roadway. Substandard stopping sight distance for the bridge and approach roadways will be eliminated. The design speed for the bridge and approach roadways is 60 MPH (100 KMPH). Necessary upland and wetland mitigation work will be performed.

candidates.title: NYC Capital Projects Dashboard recorded actual construction end for COMBINED SEWER OUTFALL N. 81ST & 19TH AVE, LAG
candidates.summary: The NYC Capital Projects Dashboard citywide budget/schedule row records actual_construction_end 2024-01-12 for COMBINED SEWER OUTFALL N. 81ST & 19TH AVE, LAG. FMS project name: Replmnt & repair of combined SE outfall north 81st &19 Ave; ten-year plan category: REPLACEMENT OR AUGMENTATION OF EXISTING SYSTEMS; managing/sponsor agency: DDC / DEP. The proposed project involves the reconstruction and replacement of a short length of an existing sewer and an outfall that discharges into Bowery Bay (see Figures C-4a and C-4b); this sewer and outfall reconstruction is proposed to address what is currently a partially collapsed outfall. Replacement would restore the outfall's necessary functions and avoid a potential full collapse and failure. Specifically, the proposed project includes the following: Installation of a new a 14-foot 7-inch-wide by 8-foot-high combined sewer outfall (referenced as the Bowery Bay [BB]-005 outfall) which discharges into Bowery Bay, thereby replacing the currently collapsed outfall. The proposed outfall would be reconstructed at the same location as the existing outfall and within an existing sewer easement across land that is owned by the City of New York and under the jurisdiction of the Department of Small Business Services. The proposed sewer and outfall design calls for a reinforced concrete structure supported on a concrete cradle with a flap gate at the outlet to control any inflow of tidal water from the bay. Additionally, boulders are proposed to be installed to stabilize the bottom of the bay to minimize the potential for scour and resuspension of sediments into the water column that may otherwise occur when there is flow from the outfall. Reconstruction of a 60-foot-long by 14-foot-7-inch wide and 8-foot-high combined sewer that flows into and connects with the proposed outfall.

candidates.title: NYC Capital Projects Dashboard recorded actual construction end for Queens Boro Hall Plaza: 120-55 Queens Blvd. Renova
candidates.summary: The NYC Capital Projects Dashboard citywide budget/schedule row records actual_construction_end 2024-12-16 for Queens Boro Hall Plaza: 120-55 Queens Blvd. Renova. FMS project name: 120-55 QUEENS BLVD - PLAZA, STEPS AND ENTRANCE; ten-year plan category: REHABILITATION OF CITY-OWNED OFFICE SPACE; managing/sponsor agency: DDC / DCAS. Removal and restoration of Queens Borough Hall Plaza main entrance including sloped entryway on Queens Blvd, court house entryway on northeast side of building, and rear building egress at the parking lot. Scope includes installation of automatic doors at main entrance, removal and replacement of handrails and plaza stair treads. Removal and replacement of retaining wall near court house entryway, removal and replacement of stair treads leading down to lower level, and removal and replacement of sidewalk leading from Queens Blvd to court house entryway. Removal and replacement of two stairways leading into the building from the parking, handrails and adjacent walkways along with 5-10' of pavement on either side.

candidates.title: NYC Capital Projects Dashboard recorded actual construction end for Hunters Point Library Emergency ADA Modifications
candidates.summary: The NYC Capital Projects Dashboard citywide budget/schedule row records actual_construction_end 2025-06-26 for Hunters Point Library Emergency ADA Modifications. FMS project name: Hunters Point ADA Remediation; ten-year plan category: REPLACEMENT BRANCHES; managing/sponsor agency: DDC / QBPL. A recently constructed Queens Public Library requires modifications to bring the interior space into compliance with the 2010 ADA Standards and ICC A117.1. Work includes structural modifications to and installation of elevated skywalks, including, but not limited to, adding a new skywalk, adjusting slopes of walking surfaces, extending landings, installing edge protection, and modifying adjoining protective guards and handrails. In addition, structural work will be required to support existing elevated concrete slabs, for the installation of a new vertical platform lift. Work also includes minor plumbing and electrical work to relocate and remove existing plumbing fixtures, add automatic door openers, add receptacles at public workstations, relocate automatic flush sensors at accessible toilets, and adjust the mounting heights of controls and switches. Furthermore, associated toilet room accessories such as diaper changing stations, grab bars, dispensers, and toilet compartment partitions require replacement, relocation, and/or modification. Finally, millwork and wood finishes must be repaired or replaced, in-kind, and new millwork will be required to modify existing reading areas/tiered seating, by creating multiple accessible wheelchair spaces, and adjoining companion seating.
